description: This file defines the SiteForCookies class, which manages the concept of 'same-site' for cookies based on URL schemes and domains, including schemeful and schemeless policies. It provides methods for creating, comparing, and serializing site representations used in cookie security policies.

classes.name: SiteForCookies
classes.description: Represents a site for cookie policies, considering schemeful and schemeless policies, with methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Constructs a SiteForCookies instance from untrusted RPC data, validating the input.

methods.name: FromOrigin
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies from a URL origin, returning a null site if the origin is opaque.

methods.name: FromUrl
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies from a URL.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the site for debugging.

methods.name: IsFirstParty
methods.description: Checks if a URL is considered first-party relative to this site.

methods.name: IsFirstPartyWithSchemefulMode
methods.description: Checks first-party status with optional schemeful consideration.

methods.name: IsEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if another SiteForCookies is equivalent to this one.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeSiteAndRevise
methods.description: Revises the site based on frame tree origin comparison, nullifying if not first-party.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeOriginAndRevise
methods.description: Converts an origin to SchemefulSite and compares for revision.

methods.name: RepresentativeUrl
methods.description: Returns a URL representative of this site.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the site.

methods.name: registrable_domain
methods.description: Returns the registrable domain of the site.

methods.name: schemefully_same
methods.description: Indicates if the site is schemefully same.

methods.name: SetSchemefullySameForTesting
methods.description: Sets the schemefully_same flag for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the site matches nothing, considering schemeful policy.
